mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) over the horizon despite sustained GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) crosses above 4.5%, indicating monetary tightening, S&P 500 20d returns turn negative as higher interest rates compress equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain non-negative when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth (GDPC1) rises and unemployment (UNRATE) falls, both positive signals for economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 20d returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when both GDPC1 rises and UNRATE falls over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 > 12000), S&P 500 20d returns turn negative as investors anticipate peak and pullback.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain non-negative when GDPC1 stays above 12000 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 6%, improving labor market conditions, S&P 500 20d returns become positive as confidence in the economy rises.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when UNRATE falls below 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When both the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPIAUCSL (inflation) rise (tightening monetary policy), S&P 500 20d returns turn negative as higher rates compress equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly negative (p>0.05) when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls and the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) rises (tightening labor market and monetary policy), S&P 500 20d returns become positive as improved labor conditions offset rate hikes.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when UNRATE falls and FEDFUNDS rise over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: When both supply growth (INDPRO) and demand (GDPC1) rise simultaneously, S&P 500 20d returns turn positive as increased production capacity supports market confidence.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when both INDPRO and GDPC1 rise over the horizon.
